description: Charged. Create a collection and start an ingest job for the given YouTube URLs in one call. Maps to POST /v1/transcribe. $0.10/min standard, $0.25/min whisper by default, 1-minute minimum per video. Pass a `quote_id` from `quote` to be charged exactly that price. Returns `job_id`, `collection_id` and `collection_token` (`ct_…`, shown once: store it; it reads this collection without an API key). Poll `get_status` every 10–30 s until `status` is completed, partial or failed; `completed` means every accepted video is transcribed and indexed, so the collection is queryable. With an API key it needs the key's `write` scope. Without an API key this tool is payable in USDC via x402: the first call returns a payment-required result (`isError` with the payment requirements in `structuredContent`); an x402-aware MCP client signs and retries the same call with `_meta['x402/payment']`, and the receipt returns in the result's `_meta['x402/payment-response']`. Never pay again after a 409 (already presented) or 502 (settlement unknown) result. Keyless `transcribe` takes one channel-like source and at most 3 videos. Prices are the service defaults; `quote` returns the exact price.

exclude_shorts.description: Skip videos of 3 minutes or less when expanding a channel or playlist (default true); explicit video URLs are never skipped.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 hint for transcription, e.g. en.

max_videos_per_channel.description: Newest-first cap on eligible videos per channel or playlist (default 25); Shorts and videos below min_duration_seconds are skipped before the cap.

min_duration_seconds.description: Skip expanded videos shorter than this many seconds.

quote_id.description: A `quote_id` from `quote`: charges exactly the quoted price (400 if unknown or expired).

title.description: Title for the new collection (default: generated).

name: transcribe
title: Transcribe into a new collection
